item.text: {"program_id":"qtclustering_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_hybrid_r3","verdict":"invalid","issue_categories":["missing_start_synchronization","missing_rank_aggregation","rank_local_timing","asymmetric_timed_region"],"confidence":"high","timed_region":"Each rank times qtClustering from its local clock after the pre-start MPI_Barrier through the post-computation MPI_Barrier. The region includes the cooperative MPI/GPU/OpenMP clustering work.","start_synchronization":"A pre-start MPI_Barrier exists, but barriers do not guarantee simultaneous return. Rank 0 can start timing after another rank has already begun work, so its interval is not a proven global makespan.","stop_synchronization":"A post-computation MPI_Barrier occurs before each local stop, so the stop is not earlier than completion of the ranks' clustering calls.","rank_aggregation":"No aggregation of timing values occurs. The MPI_Allreduce calls aggregate clustering state, not elapsed durations.","reported_value":"Rank 0 prints its own local cluster_time.count() in whole milliseconds as 'Clustering time'.","semantic_equivalence_basis":"This is cooperative distributed work, not independent complete-result replicas: seeds are partitioned round-robin across ranks, global winner selection uses MPI_Allreduce, and winner members are broadcast. The canonical duration therefore requires the global makespan, normally MPI_MAX of complete per-rank durations.","evidence":[{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1147-1149","finding":"Candidate seeds are distributed round-robin across MPI ranks, making the clustering computation rank-partitioned."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1212-1221,1276-1283","finding":"MPI_Allreduce is used for algorithmic lower-bound and winner selection, with no timing value involved."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1287-1301","finding":"The selected winner's member list is obtained from its owning rank and broadcast, confirming cooperative result construction."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1506-1515","finding":"Each rank performs MPI_Barrier, starts a local timer, runs qtClustering, performs another MPI_Barrier, and stops its local timer."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1530-1531","finding":"Only rank 0 prints its local cluster_time as the canonical 'Clustering time', without MPI_MAX or another global timing reduction."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1566-1580","finding":"Validation runs after the clustering time is printed, so validation work is outside the benchmark timed region."}],"timing_only_fix_possible":true,"minimal_fix":"Convert each rank's elapsed duration to a common wide integer type, reduce it with MPI_Reduce using MPI_MAX to rank 0 after the local stop, and print the reduced maximum as 'Clustering time'.","notes":"The millisecond conversion and integer display precision are acceptable; the defect is that an unaggregated, rank-asymmetric local interval is reported as the global duration."}
